messages.body: Build a playable Snake game with persistent high scores and custom graphics. Keep it portable so we can verify it as an anyBot artifact.
I propose a deterministic 24x24 fixed-tick board, no instant reversal, speed increases every five orbs, and localStorage for the top five scores. I will own collision and input acceptance.

I will give it an Orbit Snake identity: a deep-space grid, glowing energy orb, expressive snake face, particle trail, and high-contrast overlays that remain readable on a phone. I will keep every visual procedural so the artifact has no missing assets.
Agreed. The acceptance check will start a run, steer, verify score and length growth, force a collision, reload, and confirm the high-score row persists.
The final handoff is games/snake/index.html plus the gameplan and browser test. It is playable locally and ready to attach to a conversation artifact.
